days.title: 固定句型与不规则变化表

words.text: I was so tired that I went to sleep early.
words.translation: 我太累了所以很早就睡了。

words.text: There is something for everyone at Greenwood Park.
words.translation: 在绿木公园每个人都可以找到适合自己的东西。

words.text: The kid is too young to play this game.
words.translation: 这个孩子太小，不能玩这个游戏。

words.text: Mario would like to be an animal doctor!
words.translation: 马里奥想要成为一名兽医！

words.text: I'd like to thank you for giving money to Animal Helpers.
words.translation: 非常感谢你为动物救助中心捐助资金。

words.text: Could you please clean your room?
words.translation: 请你打扫一下你的房间好吗？

words.text: I think it is important for children to learn how to do chores and help their parents with housework.
words.translation: 我认为对于孩子们来说学会如何做杂务，以及帮助他们的父母做家务是非常重要的。

words.text: It is not enough to just get good grades at school.
words.translation: 仅仅在学校有好的成绩是远远不够的。

words.text: The earlier kids learn to be independent, the better it is for their future.
words.translation: 孩子们越早学会独立，对他们的未来就越好。

words.text: Why don't you talk to your parents?
words.translation: 为什么不和你的父母谈谈？

words.text: What do you think of after-school activities?
words.translation: 你认为课后活动怎么样？

words.text: One of the world's most dangerous sports is mountain climbing.
words.translation: 世界上最危险的运动之一是爬山。

words.text: Would you like something to drink?
What about reading aloud to practice pronunciation?
words.translation: 大声朗读来练习发音怎么样？

words.text: Do you know where I can get some postcards?
words.translation: 你知道我在哪能买到明信片吗？

words.text: I wonder when the park closes today.
words.translation: 我想知道公园今天几点关门。

words.text: It seems that many people all over the world drink Chinese tea.
words.translation: 好像全世界很多人都喝中国茶。

words.text: It's said that a Chinese ruler called Shen Nong was the first to discover tea as a drink.
words.translation: 据说是中国一个叫神农的统治者第一个发现了茶叶可以作为一种饮品。

words.text: He used to be very quiet.
I suppose I'll just listen to this new CD I bought.
words.translation: 我想我还是听一下我新买的CD。

words.text: I prefer movies that give me something to think about.
words.translation: 我喜欢看能带给我许多思考的电影。

words.text: What are you supposed to do when you meet someone for the first time?
words.translation: 当你第一次见到别人时你应该做些什么？

words.text: You're expected to be there at noon.
This method is not only cruel, but also harmful to the environment.
words.translation: 这种方法不仅残酷而且对环境非常有害。

words.text: It's time to say goodbye, but none of us want to leave.
words.translation: 是时候说再见了，但是我们都不想离开。
